name: Command search contains focus and shares real studio gestures
description: Modal focus ownership, empty search, disabled history, dialog handoff and exact Fit agreement.

planSteps.description: Use a fresh isolated desktop context, 1280x900. Open Studio, wait for restoration, retain every byte of the visible composite canvas through getImageData; if exact pixel or DOM inspection is unavailable, report BLOCKED, never a visibility-only pass.
Focus #center-canvas-area and press Ctrl+K. Search Undo. Press Enter, then search a nonexistent command; press Up, Down and Enter. Clear search. Cycle Tab and Shift+Tab twelve times.

Undo has aria-disabled=true and No action to undo explanation. It does not close or run. Empty results have no aria-activedescendant. Every tab stop remains inside the native open Command Palette dialog.
Focus search and Escape. Check focus returns to #center-canvas-area. Reopen, search Gallery and press Enter. Tab inside the Gallery and close it.
Gallery owns focus after handoff and closing restores canvas focus. Background controls cannot receive Tab while either modal is open. Report skipped focus checks explicitly.
Reopen search, choose Ellipse. Then search Onion, inspect F3 hint, execute it; focus canvas and press F3. Focus canvas and press Ctrl+Quote, then execute Toggle Pixel Grid from search.
Ellipse is selected by the Ellipse command. F3 reverses the onion command state. Grid keyboard and palette commands reverse one another. O selects Ellipse, never onion skin.

Choose Animation workspace. Compare zoom and centered pan after Fit from header, Ctrl+0, navigator Fit canvas and command search Fit. Between each, run Actual 100 percent. Repeat after importing an original synthetic 1024x1024 one-layer blank .pixibun project through public Import/Confirm Import. If upload cannot be performed, report the large-canvas check BLOCKED.

All four Fits agree on the actual workspace dimensions and center the view. The large canvas fits below 100 percent. Compare every artwork byte before/after each command group, with separate baselines before/after intentional import; view commands never paint pixels.
